request.approved_script: Istanbul, 2005. Liverpool trail Milan three-nil at half-time. Then six minutes change everything. Fifty-four: Steven Gerrard heads in. Fifty-six: Vladimír Šmicer drives in the second. Sixty: Xabi Alonso converts the rebound, and it’s three-three. Extra time cannot separate them. Liverpool win the shoot-out three-two. The comeback kept the final alive. Penalties decided the trophy.
